Fixed in d9317ba. The per-plugin key map now carries a TTL (300s, matching the
refresh bound the previous global lru-cache provided): `consumers_kv()` rebuilds
the map once the TTL lapses even without a `conf_version` change, so
secret-backed auth values are re-derived within that bound although `/secrets`
changes don't bump `conf_version`. Incremental upserts still apply structural
changes immediately — the TTL only bounds secret drift.

The lrucache has a 24-hour TTL After expiry, create_tracer_obj is called again. At that point `id_generator.new_ids` is already the closure from the previous call, so `_original_new_ids` captures the already-overridden function. Each 24h expiry adds another wrapper layer.
